upstreamBindings.transportRule: When F13 directly emits a state transition, preserve state_name as producerSemanticId and transition_reason_name as reasonId; do not infer cue class or Human meaning from the state name.
A21 provides a producer-owned PackedScene for EvidenceMount; A17 owns composition only and does not reinterpret event semantics.

identityRules: sequence MUST start at 1 and increase by exactly 1 within a run
monotonicTimeMs MUST be nondecreasing within a run and uses engine monotonic ticks, not wall-clock time
sourceRevision/buildId/conditionId/accessibilityConditionId are frozen at begin_run and MUST NOT drift within the evidence run
producerSemanticId is producer-owned semantic identity; A21 event transport MUST NOT silently rename it
worldPositionMeters uses Godot world-space meters as [x,y,z] only when the producer owns or exposes that position
playerDistanceMeters is a mechanical scalar in meters and MUST NOT be interpreted as Human detectability

eventTypes.semanticMeaning: Exact evidence run began under frozen source/build/condition identity.
Player/session flow moved between A02-owned phase semantics.
A declared cue opportunity became mechanically available; this does NOT prove the Human perceived or used it.
A13-owned creature state/transition changed and the exact producer semantic ID/reason is retained.
A declared mechanical counter-cue/detection condition existed; not Human detection truth.
Implementation-owned threat/risk signal changed and exact producer semantic/reason is retained.
A recoverable search/reacquisition opportunity became mechanically available after loss/evasion.
A25-owned explicit observe action/request began; distinct from mere proximity or detection.
Explicit observe action ended before commitment with retained reason.
A qualified intentional observation is mechanically progressing; no Human comprehension inference.
A01 product observation-success conditions were mechanically satisfied and committed.
eventTypes.minimumProducer: A17 runtime integration consuming A01/A25/A13 semantics

eventTypes.semanticMeaning: The explicit post-commit player-facing success consequence occurred.
A16 interactive/spatial cue began using an A16/A15 semantic event identity.
A16 interactive/spatial cue ended with retained reason where meaningful.
Evidence run ended with an explicit mechanical status; not a Human outcome grade.

durability.pathClass: user:// evidence output under runtime user-data authority
durability.recordFlushPolicy: flush after every admitted material event for R1 evidence integrity
durability.finalManifest: veilwild.telemetry-manifest.r1 with raw JSONL SHA-256, eventCount and frozen condition identity
durability.rawEvidenceRule: raw JSONL bytes are evidence artifacts; summaries/metrics are derived projections and never replace raw evidence

privacyAndHumanBoundary.participantRef: not stored in raw runtime events; attach a locally assigned pseudonymous participantRef only in the Human evidence package when a real participant is used
privacyAndHumanBoundary.reason: R1 can attribute the needed product/run consequences without direct identifying data; evidence collection should remain purpose-limited and data-minimal.

consumerInterfaces.need: mount/own recorder lifecycle and supply run/source/build/condition identity without changing A21 envelope semantics
include exact recorder/contract revision in build reproducibility and preserve evidence file paths
consume monotonic event timing only for correlation with frame evidence; telemetry timing is not a profiler substitute
independently verify frozen-candidate telemetry manifest/raw file identity before using evidence in QA/admission
telemetry artifacts contain no third-party content/provenance claim by identity
emit explicit observe/action/feedback events using producer-owned semantics

validationOracles: Every event in one run has exact contiguous sequence and deterministic eventId.
sourceRevision/buildId/conditionId/accessibilityConditionId remain byte-for-byte stable within a run.
Raw JSONL SHA-256 in manifest matches the actual file.
Unknown event types or missing producerSemanticId/sourceFront are rejected rather than silently serialized.
Direct participant identifiers are rejected from event payloads.
Human claims remain UNKNOWN in the absence of real participant evidence.

runtimeModule.semanticBoundary: EvidenceRuntime forwards eventType plus producer-owned fields into F22; it does not subscribe to generic bus topics and guess their meaning.

accessibilityConditionBinding.rule: accessibilityConditionId identifies apparatus/settings only and never implies Human accessibility fit.

integrationValidationBoundary: A17 shell + A21 EvidenceMount composite replay may establish mount/transport compatibility only. Until all constitutive producer modules and one frozen candidate/build exist, that replay is not V-C9 product-candidate evidence.
